title:
$status = @(git status --short)
"STATUS_ENTRY_COUNT=$($status.Count)"
$status
"HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
"SUBJECT=$(git log -1 --format=%s)"
$stash = @(git stash list --format="%gd %s")
"STASH_COUNT=$($stash.Count)"
$stash
$rootPattern = [regex]::Escape((Get-Location).Path)
$matches = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {
  $_.ProcessId -ne $PID -and $_.Name -match '^(java|javaw|node|pwsh|powershell|cmd)\.exe$' -and $_.CommandLine -match $rootPattern
})
"JI_WORKSPACE_PROCESS_COUNT=$($matches.Count)"
$tempMatches = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $env:TEMP -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {
  $_.Name -match '^ji-(?:api-baseline|consumer|stage|workspace|artifact|session)'
})
"JI_TEMP_DIRECTORY_COUNT=$($tempMatches.Count)"
